messages:
jane_support: morning — quick pulse. ticket queue 48 (↑12 vs yesterday). any blockers? flag P1s here. I'll cover claim/initial triage for the first hour.
ops-bot: New ticket P1 #5234 assigned to michael — suspected auth regression. https://tickets.internal/5234
michael: on it, repro steps collected. blocker: need creds for customer sandbox (requested from security).
alejandro: handled 8 tickets overnight, closed 6 (mostly billing/usage). no blockers on my side.
sophie: seeing repeated 'model timeout' alerts from eu-region dedicated nodes — routing fallback triggered twice, customers saw degraded latency. filing a short blameless note.
jane_support: @sophie — can you draft a quick macro for impacted customers? maybe base on 'apology-timeout-3' + status page link. also add ops note for eng: run `runtest --region eu --load 200` when repro'ing.
michael: shared sandbox creds in 10m. pinging infra for more logs. @ops-bot can you paste the recent nginx error snippet?
ops-bot: log snippet attached: ```[2026-05-01T06:13:22Z] upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream, client=10.0.5.12, server=redwood-internal```
alejandro: re: macros — proposing new macro name `eu-timeout-notice`. Body: short apology, retry suggestion, offer priority escalation. I'll draft and post for review.
sophie: small add — include one-line troubleshooting ask: "please include request ID + model name + seq_len". that cuts TTR a lot.
jane_support: plan for today: 1) own triage for P1 #5234 until resolved, 2) roll out `eu-timeout-notice` macro (alejandro), 3) update central macros doc and link in replies. ping me for handoff. post updates here.
michael: update +20m — repro confirmed, KV cache spike correlates with timeouts; collating logs, sending to eng-runtime. no ETA yet.
alejandro: draft posted to #macros-review, requesting review by 12:00 PT. tagging @sophie @jane_support for wording.
sophie: reviewed, suggested wording tweak and added escalation CTA. lgtm after change.
jane_support: thanks all — I'll publish the macro after edits and add it to the triage checklist. keep P1 updates here only. :thumbsup:
